title: Terraform IaC Security Scanning & Cloud Misconfiguration Remediation
description: Students write deliberately insecure Terraform infrastructure code, scan it with Checkov and tfsec to discover misconfigurations, remediate all findings, and then deploy the hardened infrastructure to AWS, verifying the security controls are in effect.
objective: Students will write and scan insecure Terraform code, understand each IaC security finding and its cloud risk, implement remediations that pass all Checkov and tfsec checks, and deploy and validate a hardened AWS environment.

steps.title: Install Tools & Write Insecure Terraform Configuration
steps.instructions:
Install the scanning tools and create a deliberately insecure Terraform configuration to work with.

```bash
# Install Terraform
curl -fsSL https://releases.hashicorp.com/terraform/1.7.0/terraform_1.7.0_linux_amd64.zip -o tf.zip
unzip tf.zip && sudo mv terraform /usr/local/bin/

# Install Checkov
pip install checkov

# Install tfsec
curl -L https://github.com/aquasecurity/tfsec/releases/latest/download/tfsec-linux-amd64 -o tfsec
chmod +x tfsec && sudo mv tfsec /usr/local/bin/

# Create working directory
mkdir ~/lab09b && cd ~/lab09b
```

Create `main.tf` with intentional vulnerabilities:

```hcl
# ~/lab09b/main.tf — INTENTIONALLY INSECURE — DO NOT USE IN PRODUCTION
provider "aws" {
  region = "eu-west-1"
}

# ISSUE 1: SSH open to the internet
resource "aws_security_group" "web_sg" {
  name        = "web-server-sg"
  description = "Web server security group"

  ingress {
    from_port   = 22
    to_port     = 22
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]  # Bad: SSH open to all
  }

  ingress {
    from_port   = 3306
    to_port     = 3306
    protocol    = "tcp"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]  # Bad: MySQL open to all
  }

  egress {
    from_port   = 0
    to_port     = 0
    protocol    = "-1"
    cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
  }
}

# ISSUE 2: Public S3 bucket, no encryption, no versioning, no logging
resource "aws_s3_bucket" "data" {
  bucket = "company-data-insecure-12345"
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket_acl" "data" {
  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.data.id
  acl    = "public-read"  # Bad: public access
}

# ISSUE 3: CloudTrail without log file integrity
resource "aws_cloudtrail" "main" {
  name                  = "main-trail"
  s3_bucket_name        = aws_s3_bucket.data.id
  enable_logging        = true
  # Missing: enable_log_file_validation = true
  # Missing: is_multi_region_trail = true
}
```

steps.title: Run Security Scanners & Document Findings
steps.instructions:
Scan the Terraform configuration with both tools and catalogue every finding.

```bash
cd ~/lab09b

# Run Checkov
checkov -f main.tf --output cli

# Run Checkov with JSON output for structured review
checkov -f main.tf --output json > checkov_results.json

# Count findings by severity
cat checkov_results.json | jq '.results.failed_checks | group_by(.check_result.result) | map({result: .[0].check_result.result, count: length})'

# Run tfsec
tfsec main.tf

# tfsec with sarif output
tfsec main.tf --format sarif > tfsec_results.sarif
```

Document EVERY finding in a table:

| Tool | Check ID | Resource | Description | Severity |
|------|----------|----------|-------------|----------|
| Checkov | CKV_AWS_24 | aws_security_group.web_sg | Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0:22 | HIGH |
| Checkov | CKV_AWS_25 | aws_security_group.web_sg | ... | HIGH |
| Checkov | CKV_AWS_18 | aws_s3_bucket.data | Ensure S3 has access logging | MEDIUM |
| Checkov | CKV_AWS_19 | aws_s3_bucket.data | Ensure S3 has encryption | HIGH |
| Checkov | CKV_AWS_21 | aws_s3_bucket.data | Ensure S3 versioning enabled | LOW |
| Checkov | CKV2_AWS_6 | aws_s3_bucket.data | Public access block required | CRITICAL |
| Checkov | CKV_AWS_36 | aws_cloudtrail.main | CloudTrail log file validation | MEDIUM |

Count total: HIGH __  MEDIUM __  LOW __

steps.title: Remediate All Findings
Verify Remediation with Re-Scan
steps.instructions:
Confirm all findings are resolved by re-running both scanners against the fixed file.

```bash
# Run Checkov against remediated file
checkov -f main_secure.tf --output cli

# Should show 0 FAILED checks
# Capture results
checkov -f main_secure.tf --output json > checkov_secure_results.json
cat checkov_secure_results.json | jq '.summary'

# Run tfsec against remediated file
tfsec main_secure.tf

# Compare pass/fail counts
echo "=== Original ===" && checkov -f main.tf --output cli 2>&1 | grep 'passed checks'
echo "=== Hardened ===" && checkov -f main_secure.tf --output cli 2>&1 | grep 'passed checks'
```

Screenshot the Checkov output showing 0 failed checks on `main_secure.tf`.

If any findings remain, address them before proceeding:
- Read the check ID in the Checkov docs: https://www.checkov.io/5.Policy%20Index/terraform.html
- Understand the security rationale
- Add the required Terraform block or attribute

steps.title: Deploy & Validate Hardened Infrastructure
steps.instructions:
Deploy the secure Terraform configuration to AWS and verify controls are active via the CLI.

```bash
cd ~/lab09b

# Initialise Terraform
terraform init

# Preview changes
terraform plan -target=aws_s3_bucket.data -out=plan.tfplan

# Apply (creates S3 bucket only for cost safety — skip SG/CloudTrail in free tier)
terraform apply plan.tfplan

# Verify: S3 public access block is ON
BUCKET=$(terraform output -raw s3_bucket_name 2>/dev/null || echo "company-data-secure-12345")
aws s3api get-public-access-block --bucket $BUCKET
# Should show all 4 settings as true

# Verify: encryption is configured
aws s3api get-bucket-encryption --bucket $BUCKET
# Should show aws:kms

# Verify: versioning is enabled
aws s3api get-bucket-versioning --bucket $BUCKET
# Should show: Status: Enabled
```

**Write your IaC Security Assessment section:**

| Control | Terraform Resource | Checkov Check | Before | After |
|---------|--------------------|---------------|--------|-------|
| No public SSH | aws_security_group | CKV_AWS_24 | FAIL | PASS |
| S3 public access block | aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block | CKV2_AWS_6 | FAIL | PASS |
| S3 encryption | aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration | CKV_AWS_19 | FAIL | PASS |
| S3 versioning | aws_s3_bucket_versioning | CKV_AWS_21 | FAIL | PASS |
| CloudTrail integrity | aws_cloudtrail | CKV_AWS_36 | FAIL | PASS |

```bash
# Cleanup to avoid charges
terraform destroy -target=aws_s3_bucket.data -auto-approve
```

expected_output: An IaC Security Assessment report (PDF) covering: Checkov and tfsec output for the insecure configuration (full findings table), the remediated Terraform code (both files included), re-scan output showing 0 failed checks, AWS CLI verification output confirming controls are active on deployed resources, and a before/after control summary table.
